title: Apply for a motor vehicle repairer licence
summary: Learn about the requirements and steps to apply for a motor vehicle repairer licence in NSW.
intro:
If you're a self-employed motor vehicle repairer, or you run a motor vehicle repair business in NSW, you must have a motor vehicle repairer licence.

You can apply for a 1-year, 3-year or 5-year licence online.

Note: All workers you employ must be qualified and certified in the classes of repair work they do.
who_can_apply: Be considered fit and proper for the purposes of the licence (NSW Fair Trading checks and considers police records).
Have sufficient financial resources to carry on your business in accordance with the requirements of Fair Trading.
Have approval from the relevant local council.
what_you_need: Personal details (name, address, and date of birth) of the individual or business partners.
Business details, including the registered name, address, and incorporation date.
Australian Company Number (ACN) or Australian Business Number (ABN).
If employing a business manager, a completed Manager's Consent Form (a separate form is needed for each manager).

how_to_steps.text: Log in or create an account.
Follow the prompts to apply for a licence.
Download and complete the relevant PDF form:
Submit your application with payment at a Service NSW Centre.

faqs.q: Who needs a motor vehicle repairer licence?
faqs.a: Self-employed motor vehicle repairers, or those who run a motor vehicle repair business in NSW, must have a licence.
You can apply for a 1-year, 3-year, or 5-year licence.

faqs.q: What must my employees be qualified in?
faqs.a: All workers you employ must be qualified and certified in the classes of repair work they do.
